method: Each merged product was matched to its live DB row(s) by company + normalised product name (with hand-written overrides for series reads, sub-model families and VisionNav (V)/(VL)/(VM)-NN suffix codes). db_status was then re-derived field by field against the live DB value: DB null -> fill (enrich); equal -> match; multi-select where the datasheet set is a strict superset of the DB set -> extend (enrich, not a conflict); multi-select where the datasheet set is a strict subset of the DB set -> subset (the sheet is silent on values the DB already holds, NOT a contradiction); anything else with a non-null DB value -> conflict. db_status_sonnet/opus in the source dataset were ignored as stale.
